mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.CLASS_IDX, c.TITLE, c.CREATED_AT, c.PHOTO, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, u.USER_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, NVL(r.AVG_RATING, 0) AS AVG_RATING, NVL(r.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS REVIEW_COUNT, CASE WHEN c.START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND SYSDATE < c.START_DATE THEN '예정' WHEN c.END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND SYSDATE > c.END_DATE THEN '종료' ELSE '진행중' END AS PROGRESS_STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.CLASS_IDX DESC) AS RN FROM CLASS c LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_IDX = c.PROVIDER_IDX LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CLASS_IDX, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(*) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEW_CLASS GROUP BY CLASS_IDX ) r ON r.CLASS_IDX = c.CLASS_IDX ) t WHERE t.RN BETWEEN #{startRow, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND #{endRow, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT c.CLASS_IDX, c.TITLE, c.INTRO, c.PRICE, c.PHOTO, c.VIDEO, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.CREATED_AT, c.MAX_USER_CNT, c.PROVIDER_IDX,
u.USER_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME,
maf.MAJOR_FIELD_CD, mif.MINOR_FIELD_NM,
mar.REGION_NM, mir.DISTRICT_NM,
CASE WHEN c.START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND SYSDATE < c.START_DATE THEN '예정' WHEN c.END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND SYSDATE > c.END_DATE THEN '종료' ELSE '진행중' END AS PROGRESS_STATUS
FROM CLASS c LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_IDX = c.PROVIDER_IDX LEFT JOIN MINOR_FIELD mif ON mif.MINOR_FIELD_IDX = c.MINOR_FIELD_IDX LEFT JOIN MAJOR_FIELD maf ON maf.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX = mif.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX LEFT JOIN MINOR_REGION mir ON mir.MINOR_REGION_IDX = c.MINOR_REGION_IDX LEFT JOIN MAJOR_REGION mar ON mar.MAJOR_REGION_IDX = mir.MAJOR_REGION_IDX
WHERE c.CLASS_IDX = #{classIdx}
SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1), 0) AS AVG_RATING, NVL(COUNT(*), 0) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEW_CLASS WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{classIdx}
SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM CLASS_ENROLLMENT WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{classIdx}

SELECT rc.REVIEW_CLASS_IDX, rc.RATING, rc.TAG, rc.CONTENT, rc.CREATED_AT, u.USER_NAME AS REVIEWER_NAME, u.USER_TYPE AS REVIEWER_TYPE FROM REVIEW_CLASS rc LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_IDX = rc.REVIEWER_IDX WHERE rc.CLASS_IDX = #{classIdx} ORDER BY rc.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT u.USER_IDX, u.USER_NAME, u.STATUS, c.COMPANY_IDX, c.COMPANY_NUM, NVL(ct.CERT_STATUS, 'INACTIVE') AS CERT_STATUS FROM USERS u JOIN COMPANY c ON c.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN CERT ct ON u.USER_IDX = ct.USER_IDX AND ct.CERT_TYPE = '사업자등록증' WHERE u.USER_TYPE = 'COMPANY' ORDER BY c.COMPANY_IDX DESC

select u.user_idx, u.user_name, c.email, c.phone, u.status, u.login_id, c.company_idx, c.company_num, u.user_name, c.address, ct.cert_file, ct.get_date, ct.cert_from, ct.cert_type, ct.cert_status from users u join company c on c.user_idx = u.user_idx left join cert ct on u.user_idx=ct.user_idx and ct.cert_type = '사업자등록증' where u.user_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.insert: insert into embedded_user( embed_user_idx, user_idx, start_date, end_date, reason ) values(seq_embed_user.nextval, #{user_idx,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{start_date,jdbcType=DATE}, #{end_date,jdbcType=DATE}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: update embedded_user set end_date = sysdate where user_idx = #{userIdx} and end_date is null
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMBEDDED_USER ( EMBED_USER_IDX, USER_IDX, START_DATE, END_DATE, REASON ) VALUES ( SEQ_EMBED_USER.NEXTVAL, #{userIdx}, TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), CASE WHEN #{endDate} IS NULL OR #{endDate} = '' THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, #{reason} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EMBEDDED_USER SET END_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE EMBED_USER_IDX = ( SELECT MAX(e2.EMBED_USER_IDX) FROM EMBEDDED_USER e2 WHERE e2.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} )

UPDATE cert SET get_date = CASE WHEN #{get_date} IS NULL OR #{get_date} = '' THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{get_date}, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, cert_from = #{cert_from}, cert_type = #{cert_type}, cert_status = '승인' WHERE user_idx = #{user_idx} AND cert_type = '사업자등록증'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CERT ( CERT_IDX, USER_IDX, CERT_NAME, CERT_TYPE, CERT_STATUS, GET_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_CERT.NEXTVAL, #{user_idx}, '사업자등록증', '사업자등록증', #{cert_status}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT CERT_FILE FROM CERT WHERE USER_IDX = #{userIdx} AND CERT_TYPE = '사업자등록증'
